verdict.rationale: Letta is a memory-centric agent platform, so this story applies. However, the evidence never documents an API that returns a token-budgeted, prompt-ready context block assembled from relevant memories in one call. Memory is managed inside the agent harness (MemFS, memory blocks, dreaming). The MemFS Search mod and the /doctor token-usage audit are adjacent features, not this retrieval capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can retrieve a token-budgeted, prompt-ready context block assembled from relevant memories in one call
